title: System Bot and Project Manager
description: System Bot delegates the run to Project Manager. Project Manager reports plan readiness, the five Foreman worker pools, verification, and final handoff back to System Bot.

messages.text: Project Manager, own this build. Coordinate Designer for the image-to-blueprint pass, then coordinate Foreman-A through Foreman-E, each with one 20-worker pool.
messages.systemLog: orchestrator INFO assign owner=project-manager routing=user-system -> system-pm

messages.text: Accepted. I will request a Designer blueprint first, then convert the result into role-based Foreman work packets with shared locks and checkpoints.
Designer returned placements.jsonl, stage_preview.schem, and uncertainty notes. I am planning five simple Foreman packets: A through E.
messages.systemLog: pm INFO blueprint rows=9274 materials=18 uncertain=23 plan_packets=A,B,C,D,E

messages.text: Foreman dispatch is ready: Foreman-A through Foreman-E, five worker-pool rooms, and 100 total workers. Each pool will report aggregate progress plus exceptions only.
messages.systemLog: pm INFO foreman_pools=5 workers=100 pool_size=20 locks=shared_axis checkpoints=9 temp_tag_prefix=tmp/

messages.text: Final audit passed. The world diff matches the blueprint after approved fixes, and no temporary tags remain in the exported schematic.
messages.systemLog: verify INFO pass final_blocks=9274 checksum=0f33d0a9... report=audit/report.json final=final/final_world.schem

messages.text: Returning final_world.schem, report.json, replay.jsonl, logs/*.log, and original input metadata to System Bot for the user-facing completion message.
messages.systemLog: package INFO tar --zstd -cf final/craft_tiantan_build_001.tar.zst final_world.schem audit/report.json logs/*.log replay.jsonl run.json
